podcast.body: This quicky mashup was the title track from the "Who's That Girl" movie soundtrack, combining the "throbbing baseline of open your heart" with Latin flavor and Spanish chorus lyrics, similar to "La Isla Bonita." It reached number one on the Hot 100 a couple of weeks after the movie had tanked at the box office. Despite being a number one hit, this song was notably omitted from "The Immaculate Collection." "Who's That Girl The Song reached the Hot 100's top 10 in the summer of 1987."

podcast.body: This song reached number one on Billboard's Hot 100 the week ending August 22nd, 1987. Its imperial success was so profound that Madonna famously omitted it from her greatest hits album just three years later. "The week ending August 22nd, 1987, when who's that girl by Madonna reached number one on Billboard's Hot 100."
